rows.acip: DES NA, LAS CAN GYI 'GRO BA GSUM GYIS BRLAN ZHING GSHER BA PHOR PA GANG LA CIG CAR DU BLTAS PA DE'I TSE, TSAD MTSUNGS NGES PAR DGOS PA MA YIN TE, DGOS NA, PHOR PA GANG PO DE'I NANG DU GNAS KYI BLOS GNAS SHING , THA MAL GYI MIG SHES KYIS MI BZOD PA'I SROG CHAGS PHRA MO'I MIG SHES KYIS KYANG , DE'I TSAD MAR 'GRO DGOS PA DANG , RGYA MTSO'I NANG NA GNAS PA'I SROG CHAGS PHRA MO'I MIG SHES KYIS KYANG , RGYA MTSO'I TSAD LA TSAD MAR 'GRO DGOS PA DANG , LHA MA YIN 'GA' ZHIG LA, MTSON CHA PHOR GANG SNANG DGOS PA LA SOGS PA'I SKYON YOD PA'I PHYIR,
rows.wylie: des na, las can gyi 'gro ba gsum gyis brlan zhing gsher ba phor pa gang la cig car du bltas pa de'i tshe, tshad mtshungs nges par dgos pa ma yin te, dgos na, phor pa gang po de'i nang du gnas kyi blos gnas shing , tha mal gyi mig shes kyis mi bzod pa'i srog chags phra mo'i mig shes kyis kyang , de'i tshad mar 'gro dgos pa dang , rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa'i srog chags phra mo'i mig shes kyis kyang , rgya mtsho'i tshad la tshad mar 'gro dgos pa dang , lha ma yin 'ga' zhig la, mtshon cha phor gang snang dgos pa la sogs pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir
rows.english: In conclusion now, let us consider again these three kinds of beings, each with their different karma, as they sit down together and look at a glass full of something wet and flowing. It's not necessarily true that they must all have valid perceptions which are identical. If they did, then the three beings looking at the glass of water would have to think of the water as a place to live, in the way that a creature living in water would. The three beings as well would have to see the water in the same way that microscopic organisms living in the water, little beings imperceptible to normal visual consciousness, see it with their own visual consciousness. Then too the visual consciousness of microscopic organisms living in the depths of the ocean would have to be a valid perception towards the entire extent of the sea. And certain kinds of near-gods too would have to see weapons as glasses of water, and on and on; the problems raised would be many.

rows.english: (Speak then to the disciple these words, so they understand what is happening:) The two of you, The Man and Woman, Go into union. The Wish for enlightenment Flows from the top of your heads To your throats, Bringing you ecstasy. From your throats then It flows to your hearts, Bringing you high ecstasy. Flowing from your hearts To your navels, It brings you incredible ecstasy. From your navels it flows To the tips of your secret places, Bringing you simultaneous bliss. And it is this simultaneous bliss, Indivisible ecstasy and voidness, Which is the true essence Of this, the third initiation.

rows.acip: BAm YIG NANG GI RDO RJE BTZUN MO'I MCHOG ,CES PA'I DON PHYI'I LAS RGYA DANG SNYOMS PAR ZHUGS PA LA BRTEN NAS PHYAG RGYA'I BHA GA NAS RLUNG SPOS RENG GI DUD PA LTA BU BYUNG BAS NANG GI THUR SEL GYI RLUNG GYEN DU LDOG NAS LTE BA'I BTZUN MO KHAMS DMAR PO ME'I RANG BZHIN DE SBAR BA LA BRTEN NAS SPYI BO'I KHAMS DKAR PO HE RU KA'I NGO BOR GNAS PA DE ZHU, DE GNYIS SNYING KHAR 'DU 'PHROD BYAS PAS NA DE LTA BU'I RANG ZHAL MTHONG BA'I RTZE DGAS ROL BAR ZHOG CES PA DANG,

rows.english: The next line of His prayer, which mentions "the inner Angel, Supreme Queen of Diamond, the sacred sound of vam," refers to the following process.  When you enjoy union with your outer partner of ritual, a wind comes from Her secret place, like a stream of smoke from a stick of incense.  This forces the downward-clearing wind within your own body to reverse direction and come up. This then causes the Queen at your navel (the red element, which is of the nature of fire) to blaze.  This blazing in turn causes the white element at the tip of your head (which is of the nature of Heruka) to melt down.  And then these two elements come together and collide at the heart.  What Master Tsarchen is praying for then is that He might laugh and play in the bliss of seeing the Angel's true face in this sense.

rows.english: We come to a point in the text then where it talks about "how we turn union with an actual, outside partner into a practice for the control of the inner winds." rows.english: The next line of His prayer, which mentions "the inner Angel, Supreme Queen of Diamond, the sacred sound of vam," refers to the following process.  When you enjoy union with your actual, outer partner, a wind comes from Her secret place, like a stream of smoke from a stick of incense. What Master Tsarchen is praying for then is that He might laugh and play in the bliss of seeing the Angel's true face in this sense.

rows.english: The Golden Harvest explains these offerings as follows.  The outer offering consists of the offering of the five objects of enjoyment: the objects of the senses.
